[NSTG.4.4] **Async hydration.** For backends with
non-trivial query latency, the cb queues the work
onto its own runtime and returns DS_OK without
asserting. The hydrated facts arrive later when the
queued work completes; the integrator's runtime then
calls `ds_engine_assert` from the pump thread. Same
async-marshal-back-to-pump-thread caveat as the
general call pattern.
